# Extensions on validation and test (generated by `scripts/run_extensions_xgb.py`)

Git commit `076bb6773f`. Secondary, exploratory results; recipe identical for all sets (ratio target, stage-2 hyper-parameters of the horizon, early stopping on validation, 3 seeds, mean prediction). Differences are MAE(set) minus MAE(S2_ref) in MW with 95% block-bootstrap intervals (negative = the extra features help). Forecast-weather caveat: the archive's 'previous_dayN' values are treated as available at the forecast origin; their exact issue time was not verified, so they may be slightly optimistic.

## Horizon 72 h

Share of training / validation target hours with no archived forecast: S6_forecastC: 0.2% / 11.4%; S8_both: 0.2% / 11.4% (XGBoost handles the gaps as missing values).

| set | validation MAE | vs S2_ref (95% CI) | test MAE | vs S2_ref (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| S2_ref | 5,196 | - | 6,016 | - |
| S6_forecastC | 4,886 | -311 (-523 to +28) | 5,604 | -412 (-624 to -186) |
| S7_regionalFest | 5,224 | +28 (-40 to +112) | 6,035 | +19 (-36 to +90) |
| S8_both | 4,938 | -259 (-457 to +59) | 5,670 | -346 (-535 to -111) |
